The Architecture Study Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ) is designed to produce graduates who are visionary, creative, and ready to answer the challenges of the ever-evolving world of design and construction. A curriculum that balances hands-on practice with a strong theoretical basis prepares students to become future architects who can design sustainable and relevant living spaces for urban communities. The program's advantages include an industry-based curriculum, guidance from experienced practitioners and academic lecturers, and modern facilities such as the latest design studios and architecture workshops. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the micro to the macro scale. They can develop interests in Green Architecture, Urban Design, Architectural Conservation, or Construction Technology. UPJ's architecture program provides a solid foundation for students to pursue a career in professional architecture or contribute to sustainable urban development.
Uniqueness
We have a distinctive color that other Architecture Study Programs don't have
A key uniqueness of UPJ is the direct collaboration with Grup Jaya through the Living Laboratory, giving students real experience in actual architectural projects.
Living Laboratory
Direct collaboration with Jaya Group provides real experience in actual architectural projects.
Three Pillars of Excellence
- Revolutionary Green Architecture
- Urban Intelligence
- BIM & Parametric Design
Exclusive Advantages
- Access real projects and digital simulations
- Global network with renowned practitioners
- Research-based learning and actual data
Join UPJ’s Architecture program and lead the way in future-focused, eco-friendly design!
3.5 Years / 7 Semester
Bachelor of Architecture (S.Ars.)
13
Future Career
Career Opportunities for UPJ Architecture Graduates!
As a UPJ Architecture graduate, you are ready to pursue a variety of exciting career paths:
Professional Architect: Join a reputable design firm to realize your architectural vision
BIM & Digital Design Specialist: Master the digital revolution in the construction and design industry
Green Architecture Consultant: Develop sustainable solutions for green projects
Property Developer & Urban Designer: Shape the future face of cities with innovative approaches
Architecture Academics & Researchers: Continue master studies or contribute to the development of architectural science
Design Technopreneur: Build creative startups in architecture and construction
With superior competencies in green architecture, urban design, and BIM technology, our graduates are ready to compete in the global job market. Every project you work on will have a real impact on sustainable development.
UPJ – Where Future Architecture are Shaped.
Alumni Testimonials
My experience at UPJ has been invaluable. I have gained excellent knowledge from experienced lecturers and practitioners in their respective fields. This has equipped me with highly valuable skills, both in terms of hard skills and soft skills, which will greatly benefit the development of my career.
ARIMBI ALESSANDRA NARO, S.Ars.
Magister Program, Columbia University
In addition to my formal education in the field of Architecture, I have also acquired informal education in the form of mindset and attitude during my time as a student at UPJ. This foundation has served as my capital to venture into the professional world and establish my own business.
THOMAS LIENTINO, S.Ars.

Danto Sukmajati, Ph.D
Tourism Planner
Danto Sukmajati earned his bachelor's degree in Architecture in 1999, then continued his master's and doctoral studies in Tourism Development at Universiti Sains Malaysia. He has more than two decades of teaching experience and has been a permanent lecturer at the Architecture Study Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya since 2022.
His research interests focus on tourism development, particularly urban tourism and heritage tourism. Additionally, he has been actively involved in studies on urban housing and settlement planning since the early 2000s, both as an expert and team leader. In the academic realm, Danto also teaches courses that bridge architecture and tourism, reflecting his integrated approach to the study of space and social dynamics within the context of regional development.

Ar. Melania L. Pandiangan, M.T., IAI., GP.
Licensed Architect
Melania completed her bachelor's degree in Architecture in 2012, and continued her master's studies with a major in Architectural Design at the Bandung Institute of Technology in 2013. She is a member of the Indonesian Institute of Architects and is certified as a professional architect.
Before entering the academic world, Melania worked as an architectural practitioner at several consulting firms and was involved in various public building projects, including hospitals, apartments, academic buildings, government offices, and international airports. Her interests focus on architectural design that is sustainable with the urban context and airport architecture studies. Her approach reflects the integration between building scale and urban spatial planning, with particular attention to function, context, and the quality of public spaces.

Rahma Purisari, M. Ars. , GP.
Behavioral Architecture Expert
Rahma Purisari earned a Bachelor of Engineering, Professional Architect Education (PPAr), and Master of Architecture from the Sepuluh Nopember Institute of Technology in Surabaya, with a focus on architectural design. Her design thesis, titled “Color as a Form Giver in the Surabaya Cancer Clinic in the Context of Healing Architecture,” reflects her interest in healing architecture and color-based spatial experiences.
Before teaching, she was actively involved as a professional architect in consulting and contracting firms, with experience in hospital planning projects, campus development, and master plan development. She also holds a Green Professional (GP) certification as a contribution to the development of green buildings in Indonesia. In the academic world, she teaches courses such as Architectural Design, Interior Space Design, and Site Design.
His research interests include green architecture, social and environmental sustainability, and the integration of public spaces and communities. Over the past five years, he has been actively writing and publishing various scientific articles in reputable national and international journals. His research topics include elements of worship spaces, passive strategies in green buildings, social sustainability in public spaces, and political representation in urban spaces. He has also contributed to several book publications on public spaces and sustainable architecture, including Bunga Rampai RPTRA (2020) and RD2D: Pointilism (2023). His work reflects his active engagement in bridging architectural practice with social and environmental issues in Indonesia's urban areas.

Ratna Safitri, M.Ars., GP.
Housing and Settlement Expert
Ratna Safitri completed her Bachelor's degree in Architecture at Islamic University of Indonesia in Yogyakarta and pursued her Master's degree in Architecture, specializing in Housing and Settlement, at the University of Indonesia in Jakarta. Her thesis, titled "Settlement above Water and Urbanization: A Case Study of Telaga Mas Village in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan," sparked her interest in delving deeper into urban architecture and sustainable development. Ratna is actively involved in the field of architecture, specifically focusing on housing and settlement, ranging from landed housing to vertical housing. Her environmental concern led her to explore the topic of Green Architecture, and she holds a Green Professional certification from the Green Building Council (GBC) Indonesia.

Surya Gunanta Tarigan, PhD
Housing and Settlement Expert
Surya completed his bachelor's degree in Architecture in 2006 at the University of North Sumatra. He then continued his master's and doctoral studies at the School of Architecture, Planning and Landscape, Newcastle University, England. He obtained his master's degree in 2011 with a focus on Architecture and Planning Studies with Design, and completed his doctorate in 2016.
Before becoming active in academia, Surya gained extensive professional experience working at consulting firms, contractors, developers, and architectural firms in London. Upon returning to Indonesia, he worked in the retail and banking sectors while teaching in the master's program in architecture at a private university in Jakarta, before eventually joining the faculty at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya.
His research interests focus on housing and settlement issues, public policy, and urban dynamics in metropolitan areas. In recent years, he has been actively writing and publishing scientific articles, particularly related to post-COVID-19 pandemic workplace transformations, the development of private cities in Southeast Asia, and studies on social interactions in urban villages.

Ar. Titus Adi Kurniawan, M.Ars, IAI.
Interior Designer
Titus completed his bachelor's degree in Architecture in 2014, then continued his master's studies at the Bandung Institute of Technology in 2016. At the master's level, he focused his research on building technology, particularly related to fire safety in high-rise buildings, using a performance-based analysis approach.
Before pursuing an academic career, Titus was actively involved as a practitioner in various sectors of architecture, including property development (as a developer), architectural and interior design consulting, and participation in building and environmental planning projects. This experience laid a strong foundation for his integrative and technically grounded design approach.
His research interests include building technology, fire safety, and efficiency and safety in vertical building design. One of his scientific publications, titled “Fire Safety Parameters of High-Rise Residential Buildings: A Literature Review of Performance-Based Analysis Method,” was published in IOP Conference Series: Earth and Environmental Science in 2017.
His involvement in research and practice demonstrates a commitment to bridging architectural theory with technical and safety challenges in modern built environments.

Ar. M. Hikmat Subarkah, M.A., IAI.
Parametric Design Expert
Joined the architecture study program in 2016, this individual is a graduate of the Staedelschule Architecture Class (SAC) in Frankfurt, Germany, with a Master of Arts degree specializing in Advanced Architectural Design. A graduate in Engineering from Parahyangan Catholic University, Bandung, besides being active in academia, they are also a practicing architect with experience working at PDW Bureau and Andramatin before eventually establishing their own firm. They have a strong interest in contemporary geometric forms, computational aspects in architecture, as well as vernacular architecture.

Issa Samichat Ismail Tafridj, MSc.
Environmental Urban Planner
Issa earned his Bachelor and Master of Architecture degrees from Diponegoro University through the Kemenristekdikti Fast Track program, then continued his studies at the University of Manchester, UK, and completed a second master's in Urban Regeneration and Development.
Prior to becoming a lecturer, he worked as a Knowledge Management Specialist for the City Planning Labs project at the World Bank Jakarta and as an Infrastructure Expert at Commission V of the House of Representatives. Currently, Issa serves as a Scientific Coordinator in the Architecture Study Program with a focus on urban regeneration, sustainable infrastructure, and integration of social aspects in design.
In the last five years, he has been actively conducting research related to private cities, residential satisfaction, social capital, and green design, with funding support from the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation, UPJ internal grants, and UPJ-UiTM research collaboration program. Her work highlights the interplay between space, policy, and social dynamics in urban areas.

Lutfi Aulia Makarim, M.R.K.
Urban Designer
Karim completed his bachelor's degree in Architecture in 2017 at the National Institute of Technology, Bandung, and then continued his master's studies in Urban Design at the Bandung Institute of Technology starting in 2018. His education focused on strengthening his interest in sustainable and contextual urban planning and design.
Before entering the academic world, Karim was actively involved as an architectural practitioner in the property development and urban planning consulting sectors. He participated in various projects, ranging from masterplan design, commercial buildings, to residential developments in urban environments. This experience shaped his comprehensive design perspective, spanning from site-level to urban-scale.
His research interests focus on urban planning and design, with a particular emphasis on the integration of spatial functions and urban environmental quality. Additionally, Karim has a passion for architectural and urban photography, which he uses as a visual medium to explore the dynamics of urban space and form.

Ar. Sultan Yazid, M.Ars., IAI.
Computational Design Expert
Sultan Yazid is an academic and architectural practitioner who joined Universitas Pembangunan Jaya in 2025. Previously, he taught at one of the private universities in Bandung and was an Assistant Lecturer at Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB). His focus on ecological architecture and computational design is reflected in his academic and professional work.
He has served as Computational Manager and Project Manager at RLA Studio, and Parametric Tutor at Klass Academy. One of his publications on modular and organic architecture was published in ARCADE Journal (2021).
Sultan has won a number of national awards, such as Bandung City Park Design Champion (2024), Best Paper of Mosque Scientific Symposium V (2023), and Green Building award from IALI (2021). He also won the parametric design competition at ITB (2022).
His research interests include parametric design, modular architecture, and sustainability, with an emphasis on the integration of technology and local context in architectural design.

title: Profil :: Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ)
content:
Profil :: Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ)
Profil
Vision
Visi Mengembangkan keilmuan arsitektur berwawasan lingkungan berbasis ilmu pengetahuan dan teknologi. Pada tahun 2035 menjadi program studi yang unggul dalam memajukan ilmu pengetahuan dan teknologi di bidang arsitektur dan membentuk Manusia Jaya sebagai pembelajar seumur hidup, yang bermartabat, berwawasan luas, berdaya saing tinggi, peduli lingkungan dan pelopor kesejahteraan di Asia Tenggara.
Mision
Melaksanakan Tri Dharma Perguruan Tinggi secara profesional dan taat asas di bidang arsitektur.
Menyelenggarakan pendidikan berkualitas di bidang arsitektur.
Membangun budaya riset menuju tercapainya UPJ sebagai universitas riset di bidang arsitektur.
Berperan aktif dalam kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat yang berdaya guna di bidang arsitektur.
Objective
Mewujudkan program studi yang unggul dalam tata kelola, program akademik dan kurikulum yang kompetitif di bidang arsitektur dan mampu bersaing dengan universitas lain di Asia Tenggara.
Menciptakan atmosfer akademik dan budaya akademik di bidang arsitektur sebagai universitas riset.
Menghasilkan ilmu pengetahuan, teknologi dan seni yang unggul di bidang urban lifestyle and urban development di bidang arsitektur.
Menghasilkan pembelajar seumur hidup (lifelong learner) yang memiliki rasa ingin tahu yang tinggi, berpikir logis dan kritis, giat menerapkan keilmuannya di bidang arsitektur.
Menghasilkan lulusan bermartabat dan berwawasan luas, kreatif, inovatif, tanggap terhadap perubahan serta berkontribusi nyata mengatasi masalah lingkungan dan kesejahteraan di bidang arsitektur.
Menghasilkan percepatan keunggulan komparatif UPJ melalui sinergi dan kolaborasi di bidang arsitektur.
Strategy
Strategi pencapaian tujuan disusun berdasarkan analisis yang sistematis sebagaimana dituangkan dalam dokumen Rencana Strategi Program Studi arsitektur.
Targets
Meningkatnya kualitas dan kuantitas dosen dan mahasiswa di bidang arsitektur.
Meningkatnya relevansi dan kualitas pembelajaran di bidang arsitektur.
Meningkatnya kapasitas inovasi, kualitas dan produktivitas penelitian dan pengabdian kepada masyarakat serta pusat unggulan universitas di bidang arsitektur.
Meningkatnya kuantitas dan kualitas partnership Lembaga di bidang arsitektur.

title: Kolaborasi Jaya CM-Prodi Arsitektur UPJ Terapkan Teknologi BIM di Proyek Apartemen :: Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ)
content:
Kolaborasi Jaya CM-Prodi Arsitektur UPJ Terapkan Teknologi BIM di Proyek Apartemen :: Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ)
Kolaborasi Jaya CM-Prodi Arsitektur UPJ Terapkan Teknologi BIM di Proyek Apartemen
Tangsel(Bantenkita)- Kolaborasi antara institusi pendidikan dan dunia industri kini semakin menjadi kebutuhan utama, seiring dengan tuntutan perkembangan teknologi dan kompleksitas proyek konstruksi modern. Salah satu contoh konkret dari kerjasama ini adalah sinergi antara PT Jaya CM, perusahaan konsultan manajemen konstruksi terkemuka, dan Program Studi Arsitektur Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ) dalam proyek pengembangan apartemen di Jombang, Tangerang Selatan.
Proyek ini mengintegrasikan penggunaan teknologi Building Information Modeling (BIM), yang menawarkan solusi holistik dalam perencanaan, monitoring, serta pelaksanaan proyek konstruksi. Dengan BIM, koordinasi lintas disiplin dapat dilakukan secara digital dalam satu platform, mengatasi kendala yang kerap muncul dalam penggunaan model 2D dan 3D konvensional.
Dalam kolaborasi ini, PT Jaya CM dan Program Studi Arsitektur UPJ secara komprehensif menerapkan teknologi BIM, mulai dari proses pemodelan hingga deteksi konflik desain (clash detection). Beberapa perangkat lunak utama yang digunakan dalam proyek ini adalah Autodesk Revit, yang memfasilitasi perancangan model 3D bangunan dengan presisi tinggi, dan Navisworks, yang memungkinkan deteksi potensi benturan antar elemen desain untuk mencegah masalah di lapangan.

Program Studi Arsitektur di Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ) dirancang untuk menghasilkan lulusan yang visioner, kreatif, dan siap menjawab tantangan dunia desain dan konstruksi yang terus berkembang. Melalui kurikulum yang menyeimbangkan praktik langsung dengan berlandaskan teori yang kuat, mahasiswa disiapkan menjadi arsitek masa depan yang mampu merancang ruang hidup yang berkelanjutan dan relevan bagi masyarakat urban. Keunggulan program ini meliputi kurikulum berbasis industri, bimbingan dari dosen praktisi dan akademisi berpengalaman, serta fasilitas modern seperti studio desain dan workshop arsitektur terkini. Mahasiswa akan mendapatkan pemahaman komprehensif mulai dari skala mikro hingga makro, dan dapat memilih pengembangan minat di bidang Arsitektur Hijau, Desain Perkotaan, Konservasi Arsitektur, maupun Teknologi Konstruksi. Program arsitektur UPJ memberikan fondasi yang solid bagi mahasiswa untuk berkarier di dunia arsitektur profesional maupun berkontribusi dalam pembangunan kota berkelanjutan.
Keunikan
Kami mempunyai warna khas yang tidak dimiliki oleh Prodi Arsitektur lainnya
Keunikan utama UPJ adalah kolaborasi langsung dengan Grup Jaya melalui Laboratorium Hidup, memberikan mahasiswa pengalaman nyata dalam proyek-proyek arsitektural aktual.

Kolaborasi langsung dengan Grup Jaya memberi pengalaman nyata dalam proyek arsitektural aktual.

Karir masa depan
Peluang Karir Lulusan Arsitektur UPJ!
Sebagai lulusan Arsitektur UPJ, Anda siap meniti berbagai jalur karir menarik:
Arsitek Profesional: Bergabung dengan firma desain ternama untuk mewujudkan visi arsitektural Anda
Spesialis BIM & Desain Digital: Kuasai revolusi digital dalam industri konstruksi dan desain
Konsultan Arsitektur Hijau: Kembangkan solusi berkelanjutan untuk proyek-proyek ramah lingkungan
Pengembang Properti & Urban Designer: Bentuk wajah kota masa depan dengan pendekatan inovatif
Akademisi & Peneliti Arsitektur: Lanjutkan studi magister atau berkontribusi dalam pengembangan ilmu arsitektur
Technopreneur Desain: Bangun startup kreatif di bidang arsitektur dan konstruksi
Dengan kompetensi unggul di bidang arsitektur hijau, desain urban, dan teknologi BIM, lulusan kami siap bersaing di pasar kerja global. Setiap proyek yang Anda kerjakan akan memberi dampak nyata bagi pembangunan berkelanjutan.
UPJ – Where Future Architecture are Shaped.
